parsed.summary: Router r3 is configured with three interfaces (eth1, eth2, eth3) for connecting to other routers and network segments. It has IP forwarding enabled and static routes set up to reach client-side networks via router r2. Additionally, it applies firewall rules to restrict traffic between the sensors segment (10.0.4.0/24) and the client segment (10.0.1.0/24).
